title: StubHub Expands AI Ticket Discovery Push With New Claude Integration
key_facts: StubHub announced that fans can browse live event listings inside Anthropic's Claude through Claude's connector framework.
The integration gives Claude users StubHub's live marketplace data, including pricing and seat-level availability, then sends them to StubHub to buy.
It follows StubHub's earlier ChatGPT app launch.
StubHub says it is the only major ticketing platform accessible across multiple leading AI assistants.
Purchases stay on StubHub's own platform, backed by its FanProtect Guarantee.
The article's web address carries the date April 2026.
quote_evidence: We built StubHub to be where fans discover live events, and these integrations ensure our marketplace reaches fans wherever they are.
Completed transactions still handled on StubHub's own platform and backed by its FanProtect Guarantee.
why_it_matters_hint: Ticket marketplaces are competing to appear inside AI assistants.
event_date: April 2026 (exact day not stated; article says 'Thursday')
notes: Article URL is dated 2026/04, so the news is about six months old although the pool lists it as 14 Oct 2026.
